narrative: A narrow part on the desk at the lodging. Three cues sit in another hand. The lines under them are not spread out for a reader. No face. The same roll. Nothing is written above the cues as a name. The hour is in the margin. The comedy's book shut beside the roll. The pause-mark is inside, and the book is not opened. The part is the one he takes.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the three cues, left the comedy shut, and went to play.
